projects.title: GoPrivate EDR
projects.description: An open-source, entirely on-device machine learning firewall for Android, built under the Project Trinity initiative. Architected exclusively by myself to perform real-time network traffic interception and threat scoring. This zero-cloud system bridges a C++ system-level JNI with heavily optimized local sequence models to detect anomalous network patterns and C2 communications without exposing any user data.

core_components: Native Packet Interceptor (C++ JNI) — Hooks directly into Android's VpnService API for zero-copy packet inspection at the OS level.
Lightweight Feature Extractor — Analyzes flow-level metadata (timing, packet sizes, entropy) to identify threats without decrypting or inspecting payload content.
Quantized Threat Classifier (TFLite) — INT8-quantized sequence model calibrated specifically for malware detection within tight mobile constraints.
Telemetry Hub — Local-only logging system equipped with cryptographic integrity checks to maintain secure forensic audit trails.
optimization_highlights: Implemented memory-safe tensor handling via custom arena allocators, completely eliminating OOM crashes during sustained heavy traffic bursts.
Compressed the ML model footprint to under 8MB through structured pruning and QAT, achieving sub-50ms inference latency on mid-tier hardware.
Designed a crash-resilient watchdog timer and state checkpointing system ensuring the firewall recovers instantly without dropping traffic.
privacy_guarantees: Absolute zero remote inference: 100% of ML execution is isolated in a native Android process.
Strict no-payload inspection policy ensures end-to-end user content privacy.

projects.title: Avani AI
projects.description: An advanced natural language perception engine for human-AI interaction. Built upon the custom V21.0-Lite architecture, it utilizes a highly optimized single-model, two-pass pipeline designed specifically to bypass the limitations of hardware-constrained edge deployments. It extracts deep semantic intent and conversational nuance without relying on multi-model distributed cloud clusters.

core_components: V21.0-Lite Pipeline — Single-model, two-pass RAG architecture optimized for extreme low-latency context retrieval and synthesis.
Intent Recognition Matrix — NLP-driven state machine that processes conversational semantics to extract precise user intent.
Semantic Chunking Engine — Dynamically parses, chunks, and indexes conversational history for highly accurate long-term recall.
Probabilistic Decision Layer — Bayesian network that fuses confidence scores from multiple NLP inference passes to generate context-aware dialogue actions.
optimization_highlights: The V21.0-Lite implementation drastically reduces memory overhead, allowing robust LLM orchestration entirely on-device.
Hardware-aware INT8 quantization preserves linguistic accuracy while maximizing token throughput on mobile and edge architectures.
Parallel processing pipeline decouples intent extraction, database retrieval, and generation stages.
privacy_guarantees: 100% On-device execution ensures conversational text vectors never leave the user's hardware.
Feature-level anonymization securely hashes embeddings before any optional cross-device syncing.

metrics.vram_target: Designed for deployment under 4GB VRAM limits

projects.title: Edubridge
projects.description: A comprehensive platform engineered for automated educational content generation and intelligent classroom API management. Leveraged rigid API endpoints, offline-first architectural patterns, and NLP-assisted curriculum generation to serve dynamic, highly scalable educational infrastructure.

core_components: NLP Curriculum Engine — Rule-based generation system featuring semantic topic sequencing and automatic difficulty adaptation for diverse learning paths.
Offline-First PWA Core — Service workers utilizing strategic caching, allowing full data submission capabilities in low-connectivity educational environments.
Real-Time Sync Layer — WebSocket-based state propagation managing live classroom dashboards with robust conflict resolution.
RBAC & Data Isolation — Row-level security implemented in PostgreSQL (Supabase) to guarantee strict tenant separation for multi-school deployments.
optimization_highlights: Database query optimization via composite indexes and materialized views, cutting dashboard rendering times from 2.1s to 340ms.
Graceful degradation protocols to ensure offline attendance and curriculum edits are queued with cryptographic signing for eventual synchronization.
Streamlined API endpoint design to handle complex nested JSON payloads efficiently.
security_measures: Strict rate-limiting and request signing deployed on all API endpoints to neutralize enumeration and injection attack vectors.
Secure authentication and data transport layers ensuring educational privacy compliance.

projects.title: CivicLink
projects.description: An autonomous, multi-agent AI pipeline engineered to process, verify, and resolve citizen grievances at scale. Built with a stateful LangGraph architecture, it features Vision-Language Model (VLM) forensics, 70B LLM-powered geolocation, automated OSINT scraping for official contacts, and legally robust draft generation.

core_components: Stateful Agentic Workflow (LangGraph) — A self-healing state machine managing the lifecycle of a grievance. Pauses for human clarification on ambiguous inputs and resumes seamlessly, ensuring zero lost context.
Omniscient Geo-Resolver — Utilizes Llama-3.3-70B to bypass brittle geocoders, instantly mapping hyper-local landmarks to strict Indian administrative districts and municipal hierarchies.
Autonomous OSINT Contact Spider — Deploys Headless Playwright to dynamically geofence and crawl government directories. Extracts and validates official email addresses, updating a Fast-Path DB cache.

VLM Forensic Engine — Analyzes user-uploaded images via Gemini Pro/Flash to extract visual severity context, detect AI manipulation, and merge multimodal data into the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline.
Legal Knowledge Base (RAG) — Injects relevant local statutes and municipal acts into the drafting process to generate formal, legally sound official correspondence from informal citizen input.
optimization_highlights: Implemented a native SQLite rate limiter and distributed tracing, bypassing reliance on external Redis clusters while maintaining strict API limits.
Architected a Multi-Provider Fallback system (Groq primary, Gemini secondary) functioning as a circuit breaker to ensure 100% uptime during rate limits or API degradation.
Decoupled Next.js UI from backend network constraints via a custom direct-to-cloud ApiClient, eliminating Vercel's 15-second serverless timeout limitations for long-running LangGraph executions.
security_measures: Complete PII Redaction pipeline executed before any data reaches external AI models, ensuring strict DPDP and GDPR privacy compliance.
Immutable Audit Trails generated for every routing decision, confidence score, and dispatch attempt, guaranteeing full transparency for administrative reporting.
DKIM/SPF signed email dispatch paired with idempotent delivery protocols to prevent duplicate complaints from overwhelming government inboxes.

metrics.end_to_end_processing: Sub-60s from raw WhatsApp-style input to verified, signed government dispatch
metrics.langgraph_node_latency: ~500ms average execution time per inference cycle via Groq optimization
metrics.delivery_accuracy: 99.8% precision in mapping hyper-local complaints to correct municipal wards
metrics.multi_provider_uptime: 100% inference availability via autonomous Groq-to-Gemini failover

projects.title: SSENSE: DPDP Alignment Pipeline & SLM
projects.role: Lead ML Engineer & AI Systems Architect
projects.description: An end-to-end machine learning pipeline dedicated to auditing Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act compliance. This initiative consists of two major components: an adversarial synthetic data generator (GAN Forge) and an Unsloth-optimized SLM finetuning loop. Built with a strict focus on functional, production-ready software over simple prototypes, the project also features a custom VS Code extension that connects local development environments to cloud-based GPU runtimes for highly efficient, serverless machine learning training.

core_components: Adversarial GAN Forge — Vectorized synthetic data generation utilizing Qwen2-72B-Instruct-FP8 via vLLM. Engineered a stratified allocation matrix to prevent class imbalance across 8,000 synthetic corporate privacy policies while employing anti-mode-collapse temperature annealing.

Semantic Auditor & Validator — A robust validation layer utilizing difflib.SequenceMatcher for O(n) fuzzy logic. It enforces strict semantic primary/secondary keyword mapping and catches foreign law hallucinations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

Unsloth SLM Finetuning (SFT & DPO) — Trained a highly aligned Qwen3.5-9B model utilizing Unsloth's custom Triton kernels and TRL 0.17.0. Employed Identity Preference Optimization (IPO) with a beta of 0.5 to enforce strict legal reasoning boundaries, bypassing standard FlashAttention for memory-efficient SDPA fallback.

Serverless Wrapper (VS Code Extension) — Developed a custom VS Code extension operating as a 'Serverless Wrapper'. This extension seamlessly bridges local IDEs with remote GPU environments, automatically handling environment synchronization and effectively eliminating local hardware bottlenecks during iterative model training.
optimization_highlights: Expanded maximum sequence length to 24,576 tokens while entirely avoiding OOM panics on a 128GB Grace Blackwell UMA by halving micro-batch sizes and strictly disabling TRL sequence packing to prevent causal mask cross-contamination.

Implemented automated VRAM Airlocks via Bash scripting to execute a Ray distributed daemon teardown and /dev/shm purge, safely extracting 75GB FP8 model weights from Nvidia driver contexts between the inference and training stages.
Optimized the data pipeline context window by dynamically caching injected law text, achieving a 30% pipeline speedup per generated policy.
security_measures: Sealed the training loops against backpropagation JSON corruption by enforcing token left-truncation, preserving the assistant's output during max-token limits.
Architected an automated False-Negative dropping mechanism inside the Reflexion loop to strictly prevent data-poisoning the DPO dataset with failed adversarial variations.

metrics.context_window: 24,576 tokens for uninterrupted deep legal reasoning
metrics.training_efficiency: Sub-10 hour end-to-end SFT and DPO alignment
metrics.hardware_utilization: 96GB peak VRAM optimized for Grace Blackwell UMA architectures

projects.title: RevExBot: Deep RL Architecture
projects.description: An industry-grade, physically simulated reinforcement learning framework engineered in NVIDIA Isaac Lab. Designed to train continuous control policies for humanoid robotics, this project develops and contrasts two state-of-the-art paradigms: Adversarial Skill Embeddings (ASE) and Mixture of Experts (MoE). It bridges raw video ingestion, mathematical kinematic retargeting, and highly optimized PPO/GAIL training loops on constrained consumer workstation hardware.

core_components: ASE Pipeline (Adversarial Skill Embeddings) — A generalized monolithic policy utilizing a continuous latent space and an AMP-scaled GAN Discriminator. Enables fluid interpolation between disparate skills (e.g., blending combat and locomotion) with minimal VRAM overhead.

MoE Pipeline (Mixture of Experts) — An isolated-specialist architecture that trains discrete neural networks for specific domains (locomotion, combat, dance), orchestrated by a high-frequency Gating Network for specialized task execution.

Universal Motion Forge — A custom C++/Python data ingestion pipeline utilizing CPU-throttled Farneback optical flow and MediaPipe. Applies strict analytical Inverse Kinematics (IK) with stable arctan2 extremity math to generate mathematically flawless URDF trajectories from raw YouTube MP4s.

Universal Motion Model (UMM) — A Split-Head Actor-Critic policy featuring a strictly Causal CNN history encoder for temporal momentum, safeguarding against future-leakage while protecting delicate manipulator (hand) gradients from massive torso torques.
optimization_highlights: Implemented PyTorch Automatic Mixed Precision (AMP) with custom GradScalers directly inside the PPO loop, enabling full Phase 2 GAN training (4,096 parallel environments) on a single RTX 6000 Ada.
Engineered an O(1) step-time Motion Library Manager with zero VRAM fragmentation, safely handling CPU-to-GPU tensor transfers across thousands of frames.

Replaced standard AdamW with SGD + Nesterov Momentum in the adversarial loops to prioritize landscape generalization over rapid convergence, preventing the policy from overfitting to noisy discriminator spikes.
mathematical_rigor: Designed a surgical 'Teleportation Mask' in the Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) logic, explicitly hiding environment resets from the Discriminator to maintain strict Lipschitz continuity.
Constructed a deterministic Ground-Truth Visualizer with time-dilation correction and Isaac Lab ActionManager parity, proving analytical IK bounds before expending 48-hour GPU cycles.

metrics.retargeting_accuracy: 100% anatomically mapped without URDF joint-limit violations
metrics.training_stability: Zero NaN gradient collapses via careful atanh clamping and Orthogonal Initialization
metrics.hardware_utilization: Full pipeline optimized for native Windows RTX workstation execution

about.short: AI Researcher & Security Architect forging secure, hardware-optimized, crash-resilient edge systems.
about.full:
I am an AI Researcher and Security Architect dedicated to engineering secure, explainable, and resilient architectures that execute strictly on-device. My work focuses heavily on deep NLP logic, V21.0-Lite single-model RAG pipelines, and hardware-aware quantization tailored for consumer-grade environments, ensuring system intelligence never compromises user privacy or operational performance.

I operate on the philosophy of mathematics-driven security and transparent infrastructure that survives real-world failure modes. Whether I am architecting the GoPrivate Android EDR entirely solo from C++ JNI upward, or orchestrating autonomous LLM workflows, my focus remains locked on zero-remote inference and unyielding system integrity.

Currently pursuing my B.Tech in AI & ML at IEM Kolkata (Batch of 2024-2028), I am actively expanding the boundaries of open-source cyber-defense and natural language processing at the absolute edge.
values: Security forged through mathematical rigor, not obscurity
Zero-remote inference as the ultimate privacy boundary
Optimization driven by real-world hardware constraints
Uncompromising crash-resilience over rapid feature velocity
Explainable AI logic over black-box predictive models
